import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # find bounding box of 5s
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 5 in row]; cs=[j for j in range(w) if any(row[j]==5 for row in g)]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    H,W=r1-r0+1,w-c0  # inner width relative
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]

            # distance to ring layers: which layer does (i,j) fall in within [r0..r1],[c0..c1]

            l=max(min(di,H-1-di),min(dj,W-1-dj))
            if l==0: out[i][j]=0
            elif l%2==1: out[i][j]=2
            else: out[i][j]=5
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
